depth.limits: Equal parameter counts/projection types/rank do not equal functional capacity or downstream processing depth.
depth.logging: All step losses, actual target/EOS masks, per-tensor gradient/update norms; fixed checkpoints25/50/100/150; no early stopping or best-checkpoint selection.
depth.objective_rationale: Prospective fixed primary objective from E2/E3; joint arms separately retain both objectives.
depth.pilot_selection: Fixed endpoint windows; technical smoke only, never efficacy selection.
depth.training_schedule: First150 episodes of the paired new Shapes18/6 remap schedule, identical across all windows.

joint_ablation_limit: Leave-one-region arms retain rank16 and250steps; reductions in capacity are explicit and preclude a pure necessity interpretation.
joint_primary_objective: episode_remap prospectively motivates demonstration use; natural counterparts are compulsory and neither is selected from results
mapping_policy: 18 fixed training and6 exact withheld bijections; independent draw per training episode; no result-driven selection
no_demo_control: Natural-label joint locus with identical query sequence, target labels and250 optimizer updates. Fewer prompt tokens/support images; no claim of equal compute.
software_preparation_status: Target arithmetic, schedules, generalized gated trainer, explicit-label evaluator and CPU semantic guards implemented. Independent source review and future evidence-bound queue registration remain required; no GPU mode authorized by preparation.

statistics.corruption: Reference-target accuracy is descriptive for inconsistent labels; consistent counterfactual reports old-target and demonstrated-new-target response separately.
statistics.multiplicity_status: No confirmatory claim authorized; comparison family must be frozen before model evaluation.
statistics.unit: 80 image clusters per task,20 per class;3 paired fit/episode seeds are repeated observations

training.logged_training_scores: selected target-token log probabilities, denominator and causal positions
training.loss_reduction: mean over declared answer and EOS tokens
training.resume: fully completed compatible fit only; never partial weights
training.step_query_order: balanced full-pool permutation per independent epoch
training.supervision: complete label followed by exactly one im_end token
